module.name: no-query-side-effects
module.description: Keep query functions from changing shared state while allowing local calculations.

scenarios.name: should allow asserted fresh array construction
scenarios.given: function getList() { const list = [] as number[]; list.push(1); return list; }
scenarios.when: the rule analyzes the fixture with default options

scenarios.name: should allow satisfies fresh object construction
scenarios.given: function getResult() { const result = { value: 0 } satisfies { value: number }; result.value = 1; return result; }
scenarios.when: the rule analyzes the fixture with default options

scenarios.name: should allow angle asserted fresh array construction

scenarios.name: should allow nonnull fresh object construction

scenarios.name: should allow optional computed local array mutation

scenarios.when: the rule analyzes the fixture with default options
